english_classification.chapter_title: The Chapter of Fasting, for it engenders a Host of Angels
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter contains zero substrate material. Teaching purity is 0.000 — no cosmological-correspondential vocabulary appears anywhere. The entire chapter is a narrative about a Manichaean archegos (church leader) who asks Mani to release him from institutional responsibilities (overseeing fasting of fifty elect, counting angels engendered). Mani refuses and encourages him to continue church-building. Content is exclusively institutional: fasting arithmetic, lord's days, elect/catechumen distinction, church construction, alms, preaching vs. individual edification. The seven-angels-per-fast doctrine is Manichaean institutional theology (Augustine confirms this in Conf. III.18), not pre-Mani correspondential teaching. The chapter is heavily damaged in §5-6 and scattered lacunae throughout. No extraction possible — no oldest teaching layer present.
